question.text: EBIT = Rs. 200, tax rate 25%, Dep Rs. 30, CapEx Rs. 40, WC change Rs. 10. FCFF =:

explanation.text: The Logic: FCFF = 200*(1-0.25) + 30 - 40 - 10 = 150 + 30 - 40 - 10 = Rs. 130. The Trap: Other values reflect arithmetic slips. Cross-Exam Context: Standard FCFF calc in XV. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Validate effective tax rate from statements before plugging into FCFF.
